reviewer: Assistant engineering review of actual waveform plots; not clinical validation
selection: Seed 2026; 240 canonical training recordings; up to 12 evenly spaced windows per recording screened; 160 recording development pool and 80 confirmation pool; category-enriched selection with one review window per recording.
decision: Keep PR41 parameters and paired medians unchanged for the team experiment. Main systolic pulses and interpeak minima agree visually on ordinary and secondary-bump examples. This is a bounded engineering acceptance, not proof that every retained window is artifact free.
confirmation: Inspected all 16 reserved training plots and detector overlays. Main pulses detected on ordinary examples, high pressure examples, and R38 fast rhythm (13 peaks/12 pairs). R33 has missed low-amplitude beats; its retained paired-median pressure summary remains representative to visual precision. Noise/spikes remain a documented limitation. No NN scores used.
saturation_rule: Reject raw ABP windows with >=3 separate exactly-constant runs >=5 samples long at the window maximum. All 11 flagged pilot training examples visually exhibit repeated clipping, across 2 recordings; R11/R12 and R37 provide additional distinct-recording clipped examples. Ordinary rounded high-pressure R09/R10/R36 are controls. Rule has limited reviewed coverage; retain counts and flags.
targeted_rejections: Inspected all 27 pilot training rejection plots. Most show loss of pulsatility, large baseline steps, or signal corruption. F01/F05 contain abrupt morphology/pressure transitions. F09/F13 include visible small pulses that fail the 10-mmHg prominence policy; do not describe every failure as artifact.
limitations: 10-mmHg floor intentionally restricts coverage of low pulse pressure; R01 rejected despite visible small pulses. Other low-amplitude windows can have missed beats, so beat-rate diagnostics are not ground truth.
Minimum distance restricts very fast rhythms; do not claim general arrhythmia coverage.
Isolated spikes can create extra peaks or low between-beat minima. Medians reduce but do not eliminate this; no broad unvalidated artifact removal was added.
Five-second window boundaries discard incomplete peak pairs, including the first detected peak as an SBP sample.
Patient independence and clinical/device generalization are unestablished.
